classification.label: frozen_stress_tier_v1
classification.note: Extreme labels identify boundary probes, not invalid settings. Categorical ranking and trait regimes remain separate mechanism regimes.

evidence_scope.allowed_claim: Shallow Swarm is robust in the frozen local uncertainty region, while the global stress map identifies explicit mechanism boundaries and reversals.
evidence_scope.forbidden_claim: The unweighted 108/615 stress-cell count estimates real-world prevalence or invalidates the paired confirmatory mechanism experiment.
evidence_scope.local_limit: The local region uses legacy_paper_fit and is not independent empirical parameter identification.
evidence_scope.global_limit: The broad map uses the learned revision simulator, one aggregate seed per scenario-community cell, and a different intervention contrast.
